title: Web client — a dialog keeps the keyboard (runs unchanged on the pre-T63 page)
about: Written against selectors both the pre-T63 page and the T63 page have, so the SAME script is evidence before and after: open the Companions screen from the depth-screen bar, read on with the browse cursor, Tab three times, press Escape. What must hold: the dialog is announced; after reading on with Down, Tab still lands inside the dialog; Escape closes it and focus is back on the button that opened it.
